 Harris County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0027
 Jennifer Watts, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
1-8-25
Counsel for defendant:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition, and demands strict proof thereof
as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure. Pursuant to Rule 92, Defendant generally denies the allegations
and requests that Plaintiff be required to prove the charges and allegations against Defendant by a preponderance of
the evidence.
As and for its affirmative defenses, Defendant states the following. First, Plaintiff's own negligence caused or
contributed to the occurrence, in that Plaintiff failed to keep a proper lookout, failed to yield the right-of-way, and failed
to exercise ordinary care while attempting to turn left. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies
Code, any recovery must be reduced by the percentage of responsibility attributable to Plaintiff. Second, Defendant
invokes the proportionate responsibility provisions of Chapter 33, and asserts that Plaintiff may not recover if
Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility is greater than fifty percent. Third, Defendant assetrs that any injuries or
damages claimed were caused by a pre-existing condition or by a subsequent event unrelated to the occurrence, and
Defendant reserves the right to seek a credit or offset for any settlement with other responsible parties.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
